"A hammer so strong, even Thor is scared of it! Smash into rocks, watch them float away as if they are as light as a feather."


Description

The Celestial hammer is a pickaxe added in the 2024 Halloween Event. It is obtainable during the event by placing a Hardened Moon Rod and a Waning Gibbous Moon Shard onto the altar found at the top of The Manor.

The Celestial Hammer applies a unique effect to any rocks it destroys, temporarily giving them low gravity, indicated by a light blue shine effect on the rock after it is mined.

Trivia

  • There was a glitch that causes rocks mined by the Celestial Hammer to have negative gravity when you pull out a fusion coil, causing them to fly upwards rapidly. As of 7-10-2024, this glitch has been patched. But there is still a bug where the hammer's effect doesn't even apply to the mined rocks, only when picking up a rock and quickly swapping to fusion coil make it fall down slightly slower.
